_comment: Project-wide configuration for SyncroEffects. Every script (simulation/* and optimization/*) reads from this file. Override with a path argument (python script.py path/to/config.json) or the SYNCRO_CONFIG environment variable.

time._comment: Temporal resolution. steps_per_day is derived as 24 * steps_per_hour. season_start_day maps each season to a day-of-year (1-365); the simulation snaps it back to the Monday of that week, so with simulate_days = 7 each run is a full Mon-Sun week. SimBench profiles are 15-min, so steps_per_hour should stay 4 unless the data source changes.

limits._comment: EN 50160 voltage band and line/transformer thresholds used for KPIs and plots.

ev._comment: Shared EV fleet parameters. n_ev wins if set; else penetration * number of loads. bus_ids pins EVs to specific SimBench buses (null = automatic by penetration + assignment_seed). Defaults from ETFA2026_InterPhaSe.

mobility._comment: Stochastic presence model used by the optimisation. randomize=true: per EV and day, trips are drawn from the weekday/weekend lists; each trip has a probability and normal-distributed [mean_hour, std] departure_hour and return_hour plus [mean_kwh, std] energy_kwh (drawn from the battery at departure). Multiple list entries = multiple trips per day. randomize=false: one deterministic trip from departure_slot/return_slot/daily_driving_kwh. Reproducible via assignment_seed (+ seed_offset); each EV gets an independent RNG stream.

optimization._comment: mode: 'decentralized' (default) optimises every EV on its own HEMS — each minimises only its own charging cost against the price signal, with no grid knowledge, so self-interested EVs synchronise on cheap hours. 'centralized' solves one coordinated model with the transformer limit. objective applies to the centralized mode only: 'cost' / 'peak_shaving' / 'flatten'. Price signal resolution order: price_csv (CSV with a 'price' column) > price_profile_eur_per_kwh (24 hourly, steps_per_day, or T values in EUR/kWh) > flat grid_buy_price_eur_per_kwh. The default profile is a typical intraday day-ahead shape.

grid_fees._comment: Network charges (Netzentgelte) added to the spot price in the cost objective. The intraday spot prices are NET (wholesale) prices, so these grid fees are the NET values too (EUR/kWh) — both consistent and excl. VAT. mode: 'none' (spot price only), 'constant' (constant_eur_per_kwh), or 'module3' (time-variable, three tariff levels per the §14a EnWG Modul-3 model). Values are the net EUR/kWh from the Stadtwerke Norderstedt Preisblatt 2026 (NSP, Entnahme ohne Lastgangmessung; net = Nettopreise, not the 19% VAT Bruttopreise). Module 3 is time-variable only in the configured quarters (Q1 & Q4); all other quarters use the standard tariff all day. high_hours/low_hours are the hours-of-day (24h) for the HT/NT windows; remaining hours use the standard tariff.

pv._comment: Additional rooftop PV systems added on top of the 8 SimBench systems. penetration: share of the 99 loads that receive a new PV system (0–1). Sizes are drawn from N(size_kw_mean, size_kw_std) clipped to [size_kw_min, size_kw_max] kW, seeded by assignment_seed. capacity_factor_json: path to a JSON file containing a flat list of normalised capacity factors (0–1) at hourly (8760 values) or 15-min (35040 values) annual resolution — e.g. exported from renewables.ninja for Norderstedt (lat 53.67, lon 10.02) and converted to JSON. null = systems are added to the network but output zero until the file is provided. feed_in_tariff_eur_per_kwh: the revenue the household earns by exporting to the grid (EUR/kWh net, excl. VAT) — used as the opportunity cost of PV self-consumption in the HEMS optimisation. 0.0 = self-consumption is free; ~0.082 = typical German EEG 2025 rate for systems ≤10 kW.

hp._comment: Residential heat pump parameters. penetration: share of the 99 loads that receive a heat pump (0–1); assignment_seed: independent from EV (42) and PV (43) seeds so the three device types are assigned independently. p_max_kw: maximum electrical power. cop: constant coefficient of performance (thermal output / electrical input) — a mean value; real COPs are temperature-dependent but a fixed value keeps the LP linear. buffer_kwh / buffer_min_kwh / buffer_initial_kwh / buffer_target_kwh: thermal buffer (hot-water tank) capacity and SoC bounds in kWh. heat_loss_kw_per_kelvin: building-level heat-loss coefficient — scales the outdoor temperature difference to a thermal demand (kW per K). t_setpoint_celsius: heating threshold (heating-limit) temperature below which space-heating demand accrues in the degree-hour model max(t_set - t_out, 0) * heat_loss; not an indoor room setpoint. temperature_json: path to the quarter-hourly temperature profile JSON built by input/build_temperature.py.

network_limits._comment: Constraints for the optimisation. Transformer limit = net.trafo sn_mva * transformer_loading_max_pct. node_connection_limit_kw caps base+EV power per node (null = off).
